{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of unique patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check how many times each patient appears
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple records: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().max()}")"}
